* Hack M6, TM, M8, and capital ships. If there aren't enough, hack 2 more ships.
* Hack only capital ships. If there aren't enough, hack 4 more ships.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: If there aren't enough ships of a certain category to hack, then hack ANY ship.

* Randomize the arrays so we don't have to pull from random element each time. Makes popping easier.
* No more ships left to hack.
* Pick target as late as possible.
* Herobetty 5.0: possible fix for a condition where the ship was destroyed before the check.
